description_en: Queries the information about the servers whose Security Center agent status is Offline
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-offline-machines --source-ip 180.113.XX.XX --page-size 5 --current-page 4 --region-no cn-hangzhou --os linux --remark 172.20.XX.XX --vendor 0 --region-id-str cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou

*   **8**: a lightweight asset
